1.text: Bless, O my soul, the Lord for all his wonders forever.
1.label: 4Q434 Fragment 1, Column I

1.text: Blessed be his name, for he has rescued the life of the poor.
[...] He did not despise the poor, nor reject [...]
He opened his eyes toward the needy.
He heard the cry of orphans.
He inclined his ear to their plea.
In the abundance of his steadfast love he had compassion on them.
He rescued the life of the poor from the hand of oppressors.
He delivered the lowly from the many, and brought the needy out of their narrow places.
[He led them] on a straight path [...]
He made their steps firm, and they did not stumble.
He quenched their thirst and gave them living water to drink.
[...] from the snare of the wicked [...] from a trap [...]
He healed those broken in spirit and bound up their wounds.
He opened eyes for those who could not see and raised those who were bowed down.
He lifted the lowly and supported those who had fallen.
He gathered those scattered among the nations and assembled the exiles from the islands of the sea.
[...] and they returned to their land [...] as at the first.

2.text: [...] his covenant of steadfast love with all who walk in [...]
2.label: 4Q434 Fragment 1, Column II

2.text: [...] he did not forget them in their exile [...]
[...] he made their feet firm and strengthened their hearts [...]
[...] like a tree planted beside streams of water [...]
[...] and their fruit did not wither [...] in all their appointed times [...]
[...] for he remembered the covenant of the fathers [...]

3.text: [...] your steadfast love is from everlasting to everlasting [...]
3.label: 4Q435 Fragments 1–2

3.text: [...] you did not abandon the life of your servant [...] in the time of their distress [...]
[...] the poor [...] your hand supported them [...]

4.text: [...] and he shall bless [the name of the Lord] forever [...]
4.label: 4Q436 Fragment 1

4.text: [...] the poor who trust in him—he did not abandon them [...]

5.text: [...] from a pit you drew me up; from many waters you raised me.
5.label: 4Q437 Fragment 2

5.text: [...] you stretched out your hand to me, and I was saved.
[...] the net of those hunting me—you tore it [...]
